summary: Rubico Inc., a Greek foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting its July 27, 2026 entry into a Share Purchase Agreement with Top Ship Inc. (an affiliate of Evangelos Pistiolis) to acquire all 500 shares of SPV Roman Shark V Inc. for approximately $6.5 million, with a $0.3 million advance credited, closing by September 30, 2026. The SPV holds a shipbuilding contract for a 47,499 dwt chemical/product tanker due Q2 2029, with a 7-year time charter (plus options) generating ~$75.4 million backlog and sale-leaseback financing at SOFR+1.80%. The board's independent committee approved the deal and obtained a fairness opinion; a cash sweep requires equity proceeds to fund the purchase price unless waived. Watch for closing risk and financing terms.
